title: Product Enumerations
description: Canonical product vocabularies, owned by PRO. Adapters map their codes TO these values, never the reverse. Add members over minor versions; never repurpose one.

ProductStatus.description: ACTIVE = a current product. DISCONTINUED = no longer supplied; may still sell until stock runs out, and may name a replacement. INACTIVE = not in use.

DefectiveDisposition.description: DISCARD = the dealer throws it away. RETURN_TO_WAREHOUSE = sent to PRO's warehouse. RETURN_TO_VENDOR = sent straight to the vendor. RETURN_TO_HQ = sent to PRO headquarters.
